24	internal class RumRequestFactory(
25	    internal val customEndpointUrl: String?,
26	    private val viewEventFilter: RumViewEventFilter,
27	    private val internalLogger: InternalLogger
28	) : RequestFactory {
29	
30	    override fun create(
31	        context: DatadogContext,
32	        executionContext: RequestExecutionContext,
33	        batchData: List<RawBatchEvent>,
34	        batchMetadata: ByteArray?
35	    ): Request {
36	        val requestId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
37	        val body = viewEventFilter.filterOutRedundantViewEvents(batchData)
38	            .map { it.data }
39	            .join(
40	                separator = PAYLOAD_SEPARATOR,
41	                internalLogger = internalLogger
42	            )
43	        val idempotencyKey = idempotencyKey(body)
44	        return Request(
45	            id = requestId,
46	            description = "RUM Request",
47	            url = buildUrl(context, executionContext),
48	            headers = buildHeaders(
49	                requestId,
50	                idempotencyKey,
51	                context
52	            ),
53	            body = body,
54	            contentType = RequestFactory.CONTENT_TYPE_TEXT_UTF8
55	        )
56	    }
57	
58	    private fun buildUrl(context: DatadogContext, executionContext: RequestExecutionContext): String {
59	        val queryParams = buildMap {
60	            put(RequestFactory.QUERY_PARAM_SOURCE, context.source)
61	
62	            val tags = buildTags(executionContext)
63	            if (tags.isNotEmpty()) {
64	                put(RequestFactory.QUERY_PARAM_TAGS, tags)
65	            }
66	        }
67	
68	        val intakeUrl = "%s/api/v2/rum".format(
69	            Locale.US,
70	            customEndpointUrl ?: context.site.intakeEndpoint
71	        )
72	
73	        return intakeUrl + queryParams.map { "${it.key}=${it.value}" }
74	            .joinToString("&", prefix = "?")
75	    }
76	
77	    private fun buildHeaders(
78	        requestId: String,
79	        idempotencyKey: String?,
80	        context: DatadogContext
81	    ): Map<String, String> {
82	        val headers = mutableMapOf(
83	            RequestFactory.HEADER_API_KEY to context.clientToken,
84	            RequestFactory.HEADER_EVP_ORIGIN to context.source,
85	            RequestFactory.HEADER_EVP_ORIGIN_VERSION to context.sdkVersion,
86	            RequestFactory.HEADER_REQUEST_ID to requestId
87	        )

100	            append(",").append("${LAST_FAILURE_STATUS_KEY}:${executionContext.previousResponseCode}")

102	    }

122	                e

132	            internalLogger.log(

140	    }
